hook: People with long COVID show weaker antibody quality and CD4 T-cell responses to herpesviruses.
summary: Long COVID patients had lower early antibody avidity and weaker CD4 T-cell responses against CMV and EBV than recovered controls, while overall antibody levels and CD8 responses were preserved or higher. The researchers profiled blood at 4, 8, and 24 months after infection. Lower EBV avidity tracked with poorer quality of life. The study shows association only and cannot say whether the immune change contributes to long COVID.
title: Altered herpesvirus-specific immune response is associated with long COVID
